I posted the ticket list in the #strategic-pod thread, replying to Nadia. It lists five Vantorre Group tickets, Mobility excluded, each with its source:

1. #8841 (Allentown kiosk, closed per Gideon on Jul 1). The Sep 30 digest describes #8841 differently, as a Newark Door 14 issue. Sources conflict.
2. PD-8841 (Allentown missed check-ins). Source: Apr 27 digest. Unclear whether it's the same as #8841.
3. PD-4418 (Door 9 dwell export timestamps). Source: Sep 15, 2025 digest. No status given.
4. INC-4821 (Hartford kiosk outage, Aug 3). Source: #inc-vtg-hartford.
5. VT-55120 (Hartford root-cause ticket). Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14.

I also flagged that my Oct 14 reply in the Hartford room said I had "logged" VT-55120. I had only noted it in that thread, so that wording overstated what I did.

I can't see the ticket system, so these come only from messages and digests. The #8841 and PD-8841 conflict needs someone to check the ticket system directly.
